_published_faq.name: How do I add Instacart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Instacart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fig-mcp.instacart.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Instacart MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instacart provides these MCP tools: cart and search_products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Instacart?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Instacart in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Instacart requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Instacart is developed by Instacart. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
